INSIDE THE LYRICS

A departure with no explanation

  • Parting
  • Dreamlike images

The Wave gives its brief parting scene a dreamlike strangeness: the departing figure is associated with the moon. There is no explanation of who this person is or what has happened between them and the speaker.

That missing context leaves space around the farewell. The lyric holds an image in view without turning it into a complete relationship story, so its emotional distance remains hard to settle. A reading of loss is possible, but the words keep the circumstances open.

ABOUT THE ARTIST / 새소년

SE SO NEON

Hwang Soyoon’s voice and guitar are at the centre of SE SO NEON’s mix of blues, psychedelic rock and pop.

At the 2018 Korean Music Awards, SE SO NEON won Rookie of the Year and “The Wave” won Best Rock Song.
